description.EN: DRYNO is an integrated ground water solution provider specializing in ground water investigation, deep well drilling, well installation, technical consultation, and ground water-related permit and administrative assistance.

sectorsDesc.EN: We work with villas, private estates, hotels, resorts, residential and commercial developments, contractors, developers, and industrial facilities requiring ground water solutions for their projects.
sectorsDesc.ID: Kami bekerja sama dengan pemilik vila, private estate, hotel, resor, kawasan residensial & komersial, kontraktor, pengembang, dan fasilitas industri yang memerlukan solusi air tanah mandiri.

processDesc.EN: Our approach begins by understanding the project's water requirements and site conditions. When required, ground water investigation is conducted to obtain subsurface information and identify potential ground water zones before determining the appropriate drilling approach.
processDesc.ID: Pendekatan kami diawali dengan memahami kebutuhan debit air dan kondisi lokasi proyek. Bila diperlukan, investigasi air tanah dilakukan guna memperoleh data bawah permukaan serta mengidentifikasi zona potensi akuifer sebelum menetapkan metode pengeboran yang tepat.

dataDrivenDesc.EN: Minimizing risk & optimizing long-term ground water yield.
dataDrivenDesc.ID: Meminimalkan risiko biaya & mengoptimalkan debit air jangka panjang.

permitDesc.EN: Beyond ground water investigation and drilling, DRYNO also assists clients with SIPA and NPWPD ABT processing, providing a more integrated solution from initial investigation to ground water utilization compliance.
permitDesc.ID: Selain investigasi dan pengeboran, DRYNO juga mendampingi klien dalam pengurusan SIPA dan NPWPD ABT, memberikan solusi terpadu dari awal eksplorasi hingga kepatuhan legalitas pemanfaatan air tanah.

headlinePart1.EN: Water scarcity is more than an environmental issue.
headlinePart1.ID: Kelangkaan air bukan sekadar isu lingkungan.

description.EN: As development continues across southern Bali, reliable water supply remains an important consideration for villas, resorts and commercial properties. Reported distribution challenges in Pecatu and surrounding areas highlight the value of evaluating long-term water supply strategies early in project planning. DRYNO supports property owners and developers through site-specific ground water investigation, deep well drilling and regulatory assistance.
description.ID: Seiring pesatnya pembangunan di kawasan Bali selatan, keandalan pasokan air bersih menjadi faktor krusial bagi kelangsungan operasional vila, resor, dan properti komersial. Berbagai tantangan distribusi air di Pecatu dan sekitarnya menegaskan pentingnya evaluasi strategi pasokan air jangka panjang sejak tahap awal perencanaan. DRYNO hadir mendukung pemilik properti dan pengembang melalui investigasi air tanah spesifik lokasi, pengeboran sumur dalam (deep well), serta pendampingan regulasi perizinan.

shortDesc.EN: Geoelectric & subsurface investigation to assess ground water zones before drilling.
shortDesc.ID: Survei geolistrik & deteksi bawah permukaan guna memetakan potensi akuifer sebelum pengeboran.

fullDesc.EN: Ground Water investigation using geoelectric and ground water detection equipment to assess subsurface conditions and identify potential ground water zones before drilling. The investigation provides technical information to support drilling-point selection and planning of the next project stage.
fullDesc.ID: Investigasi air tanah menggunakan instrumen geolistrik modern untuk menganalisis formasi batuan bawah permukaan dan mengidentifikasi potensi akuifer air sebelum pengeboran. Hasil investigasi menyajikan data teknis untuk menentukan titik bor optimal dan estimasi kedalaman.

note.EN: Final price depends on project location, number of investigation points, site conditions, scope, and project requirements.
note.ID: Biaya final disesuaikan dengan lokasi proyek, jumlah titik sounding, kondisi medan, serta kebutuhan teknis.

shortDesc.EN: Professional deep well drilling tailored to geological conditions and project needs.
shortDesc.ID: Pengeboran sumur dalam profesional yang disesuaikan dengan kondisi geologi dan kebutuhan debit proyek.

fullDesc.EN: Professional deep well drilling according to project requirements, available investigation data, geological conditions, and actual field conditions. The drilling method, equipment, diameter, and target depth are determined according to the requirements and conditions of each project.

shortDesc.EN: Installation of high-grade casing and well components for long-term structural integrity.

question.EN: Why is a ground water investigation recommended before drilling?
question.ID: Mengapa investigasi air tanah (geolistrik) sangat disarankan sebelum pemboran?

answer.EN: Ground Water investigation (geoelectric survey) provides critical subsurface information to identify potential ground water-bearing zones, estimate depth indications, and assess geological formations before drilling. This minimizes financial risk and helps select the most optimal drilling point.
answer.ID: Survei geolistrik menyajikan data formasi bawah permukaan yang akurat untuk mendeteksi lapisan pembawa air (akuifer), memperkirakan kisaran kedalaman, serta memetakan batuan keras. Hal ini sangat meminimalkan risiko biaya bor kering (dry hole) dan membantu memilih titik bor terbaik.

question.EN: How deep do you usually drill for deep wells in Bali & NTB?
question.ID: Berapa rata-rata kedalaman pemboran sumur dalam di Bali & NTB?

answer.EN: Drilling depths vary significantly based on location and regional hydrogeology. For instance, cliff terrain in Uluwatu or Pecatu may require depths between 100m to 220m+, whereas coastal plains or inland areas may require different depths. We do not guarantee a universal depth and determine drilling depth according to site conditions.
answer.ID: Kedalaman sangat bervariasi tergantung topografi dan hidrogeologi kawasan. Sebagai contoh, di area tebing Pecatu dan Uluwatu kedalaman sering berkisar 100m hingga 220m+, sedangkan di dataran pesisir atau lembah bisa lebih dangkal. Kami tidak menerapkan kedalaman universal, melainkan disesuaikan dengan kondisi lapangan.

question.EN: How long does a typical deep well drilling project take?
question.ID: Berapa lama estimasi pengerjaan proyek sumur dalam?

answer.EN: On average, field drilling and well casing installation take between 2 to 4 weeks, depending on target depth, subsurface rock hardness, site accessibility, and weather conditions.
answer.ID: Rata-rata pelaksanaan pengeboran dan pemasangan casing memakan waktu antara 2 hingga 4 minggu, tergantung kedalaman target, kekerasan formasi batuan, kemudahan akses alat berat, serta cuaca.

question.EN: What is SIPA and why is it necessary for my commercial project?
question.ID: Apa itu SIPA dan mengapa wajib dimiliki oleh properti komersial?

answer.EN: SIPA (Surat Izin Pengusahaan Air Tanah) is the official government permit required for ground water extraction and utilization. Having a valid SIPA ensures your villa, resort, or commercial project remains legally compliant with environmental regulations.
answer.ID: SIPA (Surat Izin Pengusahaan Air Tanah) adalah izin legal resmi dari pemerintah untuk pengambilan dan pemanfaatan air tanah. Memiliki SIPA yang sah menjamin vila, hotel, resor, atau bisnis komersial Anda beroperasi secara legal dan bebas dari sanksi lingkungan.

question.EN: Which areas in Indonesia does DRYNO cover?
question.ID: Wilayah mana saja yang dicakup oleh layanan DRYNO?

answer.EN: DRYNO provides integrated ground water solutions across Bali, Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, and West Nusa Tenggara (NTB) including Lombok and surrounding regions.
answer.ID: DRYNO melayani seluruh wilayah Bali (Badung, Gianyar, Tabanan, Buleleng, Karangasem, dll.), Nusa Lembongan, Nusa Penida, serta Nusa Tenggara Barat (Lombok dan Sumbawa).

question.EN: How do I request an accurate quotation for my project?
question.ID: Bagaimana cara mendapatkan penawaran biaya yang akurat?

answer.EN: You can contact our engineering team directly via WhatsApp or our contact form. We will review your project location, estimated water requirements, and site accessibility to provide a detailed project proposal.
answer.ID: Anda dapat menghubungi tim teknis kami langsung melalui WhatsApp atau formulir kontak. Kami akan meninjau titik lokasi proyek Anda, perkiraan kebutuhan debit air, serta aksesibilitas lokasi untuk memberikan proposal teknis dan biaya yang rinci.
